# MemoChain

Verifiable constant-size (22 KB) memory for LLM agents. The whole history of a
chat or document collection folds into a fixed 22,528-byte state, written in O(1)
per document, with a SHA-256 receipt chain. Bit-identical in Python, Rust, and
SP1 zkVM.

Website: https://omodaka9375.github.io/memochain/
Code: https://github.com/Omodaka9375/memochain
License: Apache-2.0

## Install (Docker, recommended)

```bash
docker run -d --name memochain -p 9000:9000 \
    --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway \
    -v memochain-data:/data \
    -e MEMOCHAIN_BACKEND_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:8000/v1 \
    ghcr.io/omodaka9375/memochain:latest
curl http://localhost:9000/healthz
```

Or via Docker Compose (starts :9000 local + :9001 OpenRouter on one shared session volume):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Omodaka9375/memochain && cd memochain
docker compose up -d
```

Multi-arch image: linux/amd64 + linux/arm64. Zero downloads needed on first boot
(built-in deterministic Q14 writer). About 55 MB RAM, 0 extra GPU.

## Install (from source)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Omodaka9375/memochain && cd memochain
uv sync --extra proxy
PYTHONPATH=src python -m memochain.server \
    --backend-base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 --port 9000
```

Python 3.12+ required. No GPU required. No checkpoint required (the built-in
deterministic Q14 writer boots immediately; trained weights.bin available below).

## Verify it works

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/healthz
```

The health response reports `weights_source` (either `deterministic` or a
path to trained weights) and `weights_digest`. A 22,528-byte capsule and valid
SHA-256 receipt chain are emitted on every fold.

## Client setup

Point any OpenAI client at `http://localhost:9000/v1` (local) or
`http://localhost:9001/v1` (OpenRouter).

Point any Anthropic `/v1/messages` client (Claude Code, Anthropic SDK) at
`http://localhost:9000`.

Optional: mount trained weights for a neural fold writer:

```bash
curl -L -O https://github.com/Omodaka9375/memochain/releases/download/v0.1.0/weights.bin
curl -L -O https://github.com/Omodaka9375/memochain/releases/download/v0.1.0/weights.bin.sha256
sha256sum -c weights.bin.sha256
```

Expected digest: `626e2089fe38bc593ebf8421873739438aa47b86408db10bafc4eb424f82d67b`

Then mount it in Docker (`-v $(pwd)/weights.bin:/checkpoints/weights.bin:ro`)
and set `MEMOCHAIN_CHECKPOINT=/checkpoints/weights.bin`, or pass
`--checkpoint weights.bin` to the Python server.

## Optional next steps

- Train your own writer: `PYTHONPATH=src python -m memochain.train_e2e ...`
  (requires a 12 GB GPU and the pv4 dataset)
- Prove the fold in SP1: see `crates/sp1/` (Linux/ARM)
